title: CEDAR · title page
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. Nobody in the house finds it strange.

panels.composition: The end grain of a cedar round filling the whole page, wet-on-wet cedar red and moss, the rings drawn out to the bark, the title carved through them in five deep letters, one ring notched, and the subtitle lettered small along the bark's edge; the glow's ochre bleeding in at the top corner.

image.notes: The notch: the novel's one rule. The 1994 ring.
